## Selected systems from the portfolio

- IMF: The International Meme Fund, a memecoin launchpad and credit desk on Ethereum and Robinhood Chain (TrueOrigin Labs). Borrow USDS against memecoins via isolated Morpho vaults; the V4 launchpad bonds coins on a fair curve with a free ENS name and gas covered. Peaked near $260M TVL. Live: https://imf.bz. App: https://app.imf.bz. Docs: https://docs.imf.bz.
- SigIntZero: Smart-contract audit and security firm (co-founder). Sentinel AI scans, senior audits, and Tripwire runtime monitoring, backed by a Superteam Australia grant. Live: https://sigintzero.com.
- Shuriken: Rust EVM simulation engine (core dev). Replays chain state to simulate a token's buy and sell before you snipe, flagging honeypots and price impact. Runs across L1 and L2. Live: https://shuriken.trade.
- Flow: High-frequency copytrading system on Solana and Ethereum (TrueOrigin Labs). Trading front-end, 0-block latency execution.
- TonsOfFriends: A social DeFi ecosystem on Telegram (TrueOrigin Labs): discover communities, play to earn $FREN, and trade in one TON mini-app, bridged across TON, Ethereum, and Base. Live: https://tonfriends.tech. Docs: https://docs.tonfriends.tech.
- Aetos: Trustless venture-DAO platform built at TrueOrigin Labs. On-chain capital calls, proposals, siloed vaults, and returns. Docs: https://aetos.gitbook.io/aetos.vc. Underpins Book Club: 500+ members, 9 teams, $10M+ collective revenue.
- Yieldly: The first DeFi suite on Algorand (tech co-founder, lead frontend). Staking pools and no-loss prize games.
- Bespoke: The mint site for a 10,000-piece NFT collection (TrueOrigin Labs): a 3D storefront, lore, and wallet mint in one experience. Docs: https://docs.bespoke.bond.
- MantraDAO: DeFi staking and governance. Full-stack product engineering in the TrueOrigin external team.
